verdict.rationale: Neon is documented as an open-source serverless Postgres platform that standard Postgres clients connect to, and it documents connection pooling and a serverless driver. That implies Postgres-speaking ORMs can connect, but the pack contains no ORM- or framework-specific guides. Missing for 10: documented Prisma, Drizzle, Django and Rails integration guides, explicit ORM migration-workflow docs, and independent or hands-on confirmation that these ORMs work out of the box.
